envelope.heading: Security Findings
envelope.description: Security findings from one survey report, or about one element, most severe first. A blank CVSS score, Exploit Available or Patch Available means not recorded. Findings written before Egeria 6.3 may show 0 or false for a value that was never set.

envelope.heading: Penetration Test Findings
envelope.description: The findings of a penetration test, most severe first - the view the tester hands back. A blank CVSS score means not recorded; before Egeria 6.3 it showed as 0.

envelope.heading: Security Posture
envelope.description: One row per security test run, oldest first, to show whether the estate is getting more secure. Blank severity counts mean the run recorded no counts; any other blank count was not recorded. Runs written before Egeria 6.3 may show 0 for a count that was never set.

envelope.heading: Statement of Applicability Controls
envelope.description: The controls assessed in one statement of applicability, one row per control, with whether each applies, why, and how far it is implemented.

envelope.heading: Control Implementation Summary
envelope.description: Applicable controls in a statement of applicability, counted by implementation status. Use BAR or PIE output for a chart.
